name: Voice of Customer Onboarding
description: Available only through an explicit package install. The Voice of Customer half of the onboarding lifecycle, fully independent of the meta-onboarding package: stages the voc-data-pull and voc-audit skills plus the VoC post-install and activation. Installation only delivers files: before connected-account reads, routine creation, or /agent/user.md changes, the activation discloses those effects and waits for an explicit human yes, offering at most once per conversation for an unrostered workspace (the legacy meta-and-voc-onboarding roster counts as onboarded). After approval, post-install opens with a transparent source inventory and asks which channels the person hears customers on, answers with a numbered plan, then creates human-confirmed workspace-scoped daily VoC sync routines (Meta ad comments included when Meta is connected; Reddit, X, and Amazon Reviews via a stored Apify key), kicks the 12-month backfills, and records the workspace as connected in the runneth:voc-connected block. Once a workspace's backfill is fully covered, the sync routine offers the Voice of Customer Audit (five buckets, gap analysis, personas), deferring while a Meta onboarding is mid-flight; the audit runs only on a person's yes, and delivering it completes onboarding - the audit skill creates a standing daily refresh routine and writes the runneth:voc-onboarded roster. All generated data is scoped to /agent/brain/<workspace>/data-sources/voc/ so multi-workspace onboarding stays additive.
